study.title: HRS-UNet: A Semantic Segmentation Model for Precise Crop Classification in Hyperspectral Remote Sensing Image
study.short_title: HRS-UNet hyperspectral crop classification; OA 0.8996, Kappa 0.8814
study.venue: Poster Volume II - The 2025 Twenty-First International Conference on Intelligent Computing (ICIC), Ningbo, China

segmentation.domain: precise crop classification via semantic segmentation of UAV-borne hyperspectral imagery (200 spectral bands, 400-1000 nm) using a U-Net-based network with Multiscale Spectral Aggregation (MSA), Spatial-Transformer and Global Attention
models_tested: HRS-UNet (proposed: MSA module + UNet backbone with ResBlock / Spatial-Transformer / Global Attention)
segmentation.best_model: HRS-UNet: Overall Accuracy 89.96%, Kappa 0.8814 (+4.54 pp OA over HSI-TransUNet baseline 86.05%)

dataset.name: UAV-HSI-Crop dataset (China Agricultural University): 433 hyperspectral images (96x96 px) with 200 spectral bands (400-1000 nm, Resonon Pika L imager) covering 27 vegetation categories (bare soil, weed, Chinese cabbage, corn, millet, others); farmland plots at Majiakou and Xijingmeng Villages, Shenzhou City, Hebei Province, China
dataset.note: Spatial resolution 0.1 m/pixel (text also has a likely-erroneous 'GSD approximately 100 meters' elsewhere). 27 distinct vegetation/land-cover classes. External benchmark dataset; per-class label counts and altitude not stated.

classes: and 22 further vegetation classes (27 total, per UAV-HSI-Crop)
segmentation.backbone: U-Net (encoder: ResBlock + Spatial-Transformer + Global Attention + Downsample blocks; decoder with transposed convolution); MSA module compresses spectral channels (4 branches, kernels 1/3/5/7) to 128 channels

mIoU.ambiguity: mIoU not reported; evaluation uses Overall Accuracy and Kappa only (Sec. 2.5).

mPA.ambiguity: Class-mean accuracy not reported (only overall accuracy).

Dice.ambiguity: Log-Cosh Dice used in the hybrid loss (Eq. 9) but no Dice metric reported.

PA.quote: our method achieves a remarkable overall accuracy (OA) of 89.96% with a corresponding Kappa coefficient of 0.8814
PA.ambiguity: Overall Accuracy (OA) per Eq. (12) = correctly classified samples / total, i.e. global pixel accuracy (reported as 'classification accuracy'); mapped to PA.

weed_F1.ambiguity: Weed is one of 27 classes; per-class metrics not reported.

edge.framework: PyTorch; 8x NVIDIA RTX 3090 GPUs, 200 epochs, batch size 8, Adam lr 4e-5, weight decay 5e-4, CE + Log-Cosh Dice loss; no edge deployment

gflops.ambiguity: Computational reduction of MSA discussed qualitatively only.

issues: Only Overall Accuracy and Kappa reported; no IoU/Dice/per-class accuracy, limiting RQ1 semantic-metric coverage to PA (via OA).
Text contains contradictory GSD statements ("approximately 100 meters" vs "spatial resolution is 0.1 meters per pixel"); 0.1 m/px recorded per the explicit resolution statement.
Small evaluation size (433 x 96x96 hyperspectral images) on an external benchmark; no inference speed/efficiency numbers reported.
